lines.before: A feature, fix or triage sweep's Swarm Contract is approved by `approve.mjs`, never an agent: same contract, same answer. It runs first: an approval prints the owner's notice; only an ASK goes to the owner (yes logged, `--owner-yes`); a hook holds reviewers until the log clears this HEAD and contract. It approves only when the tier's and modifiers' roles are there, each with its own question, context, finding shape and budget, within the tier's caps; else the owner decides, told why. First push and launch gate always go to the owner. Each decision and outcome is logged; it pauses after tokens 25% over budget, a third of findings repeated, a bug escaping a passed sweep, or every 10 approvals (the trial review; 20 after two clean in a row, 10 again after any other pause), and only the owner resumes it. Why: a routine sweep need not wait; the log shows when it drifts.
